question.text: What is the allotment timeline for ELSS scheme NFOs?

explanation.text: The Logic: While NFO allotment for mutual fund schemes is currently within 5 business days from the close of the NFO, in the case of ELSS the allotment must be done within 30 days from the close of the NFO. The Trap: The general 5-business-day allotment TAT is the most commonly remembered figure; candidates apply it universally and forget the ELSS exception. Note: Track the closure-date carefully so investors know when their ELSS units will be credited.
